name: Kesar India Limited
summary: Kesar India Limited operates as a real estate development company in India. It develops residential and commercial projects. The company engages in the business as builders, property developers, engineering contractors, civil, mechanical and labour contractors, building and erection engineers, consultants, dealers in, importers, exporters; and manufactures and exports prefabricated and precast houses, materials, tools, implements, machinery, and metalware. In addition, it purchases, acquires, rents, and leases land, buildings, and structures. Further, it engages in securities trading and investment activities in financial markets. The company was formerly known as Kesar Impex (India) Private…
